sections.heading: Kit Harington — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kit Harington was born on 26 December 1986 in Acton, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Christopher Catesby Harington at birth and is publicly known as Kit Harington.
Public records name his father, Sir David Harington, 15th Baronet and his mother, Deborah Catesby. He is a sibling of Jack Harington.
His listed education includes Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, The Chantry School and Worcester Sixth Form College.
He is recorded as speaking English.
